correctness.rationale: The characteristic-two cubic is smooth. The 27 displayed F4 lines exhaust the known geometric 27, with Frobenius 3 fixed plus 12 pairs, 6 meeting and 6 skew. The geometric effective cone is generated by exceptional curves. Meeting-pair traces split into rational effective sums; skew pairs span geometrically contractible faces and hence extreme invariant rays. The full Picard invariant rank is 4 by #X(F2)=7 and Frobenius trace 1. An explicit 7-curve geometric Gram determinant 1 and an arithmetic 7x4 coordinate matrix with a unit 4x4 minor establish a primitive integral basis; Gram det=-8, SNF [1,2,2,2]. The dual ray census checks all 84 triples of 9 extremal rays, nonnegative normals and exact supporting ranks, yielding 11. The embedded verifier reproduces all integer and F4 computations.

value.rationale: The exceptional-curve effective and nef cones control contractions and positivity of rational divisors on the natural maximally symmetric characteristic-two cubic surface. A complete nine-ray/eleven-ray classification and a minimal four-divisor integral generating set, with explicit saturation and discriminant invariants, address naturally motivated arithmetic divisor geometry. These integral and polyhedral data are stronger than routine rational point counting and are not an arbitrary parameter slice. The computation is precise and usable for intersection inequalities and rational line-contraction geometry.
